parts.label: Part 3
parts.article:
Hello Edward, sit down.

Thanks. I need some advice on my presentation about product development

Right. Have you decided what to focus on?

Yes, the product I’ve chosen is a particular type of mosquito net.

Any reason for choosing that?

I spent last summer traveling around Africa with a friend. He’s studying medicine so when we’re in a region where mosquitoes cause malaria, we visited a medical centre. I chatted to an administrator while my friend talked to one of the doctors. And I found out they’ve had far fewer cases of malaria since these mosquito nets became available locally. That made me interested in them.

Okay. Mosquito nets have quite a long history, don’t they? I believe they’ve been used in Japan for centuries.

That’s right. Though apparently Queen Cleopatra slept under one in ancient Egypt. That was probably where they were invented. And much later, nets were used in China, so perhaps they were invented there independently. Originally, they were made of silk, but later cotton was used, and nowadays they’re mainly synthetic. It wasn’t until the middle of the 20th century that they developed nets treated with insecticides for use by the military, and that was a major step forward. They used an insecticide called DDT, but it was later found that this could be harmful to people as well as mosquitoes.

Is that still a problem with modern nets?

Oh no. The chemicals use nowadays are safe, even if people sleep under them every night and the nets work and they’re odor free. But they have to be treated fairly often with the chemical, which the owners need to do themselves.

Presumably distribution of the chemical can be a problem in remote areas. I mean, people may not be able to get hold of it easily.

That’s right.

Okay, tell me about this net you’re going to talk about.

Well, the brand name is OlySet, and the product was invented by a Japanese company. These nets are an improvement on the alternatives, because the insecticide is contained inside the fiber and released gradually. It’s not coated on the outside as with ordinary nets. So the chemicals don’t have to be replaced?

Right

and OlySet nets are also tougher and don’t tear as easily. They give protection for at least five years, compared with a year or two for other nets.

Hmm. Well, it sounds interesting. But for your seminar presentation, will you provide the bigger picture as well?

Yes, it’ll be a case study of product development.

I thought I’d introduce my presentation by describing the background to the new product, the general context.

You mean the business context? Where the investments coming from and that sort of thing?

Well, I was thinking I’d talk first about insect-borne diseases, particularly malaria, and why there’s such an urgent need for new ways of fighting it. Some people might not know much about it.

Yes, that’s a good idea.

I’ve got some statistics about the numbers of people worldwide who get the disease each year. I thought I’d show those. They’re quite staggering.

I can imagine. It’s one of the world’s biggest health problems after all. It’d also be useful if you could find some statistical information on how malaria affects countries’ economic output and present that too.

Hmm, okay. I’m sure I can find something.

Hmm, okay. I’m sure I can find something. After that, I’ll talk about mosquito nets. First, the historical development, just briefly, and then I’ll introduce the Olyset mosquito net.

Hmm, yes. Keep it simple. You could just present a bulleted list of its characteristics, the things that make it different from other types of net and talk that through.

Right. Then I thought I’d outline the production process.

Fine.

Should I give some information about where the money for the project has come from? There are lots of government and private sponsors.

Hmm, definitely. That’s a very important aspect of any product development. Where are the nets being manufactured, by the way?

Oh, over half are made in Tanzania by a company called A to Z. They got an interest-free loan to buy in the necessary machinery. Well, I’d say a bit about the company profile as well.

and then present figures about numbers of staff and the kinds of people they’re employing on the Olyset project if you can find the details.

Hmm, okay. I haven’t included any information about marketing. I’ve got a lot of notes about it, but I’m not sure how to present them.

Hmm, I wouldn’t mention that if I were you. You’ve only got a short time for your presentation, and you’ve got quite a lot of material here already. But you should provide some figures about output. Have you found out from the company’s website how many nets they actually produce?

Yes, it’s over 30 million a year.

Hmm, right.

Then, I’m not sure how to finish off. What do you think about including something on potential?

analyses.content: Edward 明确提到朋友在跟医生聊天，而他自己是跟一位**administrator（管理人员）**聊天并得知了蚊帐的信息。
I chatted to an administrator while my friend talked to one of the doctors. And I found out they’ve had far fewer cases of malaria since these mosquito nets became available locally.

questions.question: According to Edward, Olyset nets are better than other nets because they

analyses.content: ...and OlySet nets are also tougher and don’t tear as easily. They give protection for at least five years, compared with a year or two for other nets.
选项 B 是错的，原文说杀虫剂在纤维内部（contained inside），并不是用了“更多”化学物质。
Edward 强调 OlySet 蚊帐可以使用至少五年，而其他蚊帐只有一两年，所以它的优势是有效时间更长。

analyses.content: 导师建议找一些关于疟疾如何影响国家**economic output（经济产出）**的数据。
It’d also be useful if you could find some statistical information on how malaria affects countries’ economic output and present that too.
上一句刚提到了健康问题（health problems），紧接着导师建议了新的方向即“经济”，不要停留在上一句的语义里。
You could just present a bulleted list of its characteristics, the things that make it different from other types of net and talk that through.
不要被前面的 historical development 干扰，那个话题已经结束了，现在是在讨论 specifically 介绍 OlySet 蚊帐的部分。
导师建议做一个 bulleted list（项目符号列表）来列出蚊帐的 characteristics（特征/特性）。
Should I give some information about where the money for the project has come from? There are lots of government and private sponsors.
这里是在 Production 流程之后，专门开启了一个关于“钱从哪来”的新话题，不要漏听 money 这个核心词。
Edward 询问是否应该提供关于 money（资金） 来源的信息，也就是 sponsors（赞助商），对应选项中的 Funding 或类似含义。
...and then present figures about numbers of staff and the kinds of people they’re employing on the Olyset project if you can find the details.
你可能听到了 A to Z 公司或者 machinery，但题目要求的是 description of 什么人，核心词是 people/staff。
导师建议展示关于 staff（员工） 数量以及雇佣人员类型的数字。
Hmm, I wouldn’t mention that if I were you... But you should provide some figures about output. Have you found out from the company’s website how many nets they actually produce?
这是一个典型的否定陷阱，Edward 想讲 marketing，但导师说 "I wouldn't mention that"，真正的答案是后面建议的 output。
导师否决了讲 marketing 的想法，建议提供关于 output（产量） 的数据，即每年生产多少（30 million）。
